overview_description.description:
Braintree's payment platform provides all the tools online and mobile businesses need to accept payments.


Providing the global commerce tools people need to build and grow businesses, Braintree’s global platform powers payments for thousands of online and mobile commerce innovators including Airbnb, Uber, GitHub, Facebook and Pinterest. Merchants in more than 40 countries across North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia can accept, split, and enable payments in more than 130 currencies. Braintree’s SDK powers PayPal, including PayPal One Touch™, Venmo, Apple Pay, Android Pay, credit/debit cards, and Bitcoin across any device. Braintree was acquired by PayPal in 2013.

product.name: PayPal Enterprise Payments Platform
product.description: A cloud-based payment processing platform that enables online and mobile businesses to accept payments globally, supporting multiple currencies and payment methods.

product.name: Adaptive Fraud Management Solutions
product.description: Tools integrated within the payment platform to detect, prevent, and manage fraudulent payment transactions and improve risk decisions.

product.name: Global Payouts Service
product.description: A service enabling businesses to send payments quickly and reliably to recipients in over 200 markets and more than 50 currencies worldwide.

product.name: Developer Sandbox Environment
product.description: A testing environment that allows developers to simulate and test payment processing, subscriptions, and API integrations before going live.

product.name: Payment Data Sharing Integration
product.description: A single integration platform that allows businesses to share payment data with other service providers to support growth and operational efficiency.
